title: Can You Take a Baby or Toddler on a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Yes, with planning: tell us the exact ages when you book, pick a calm morning, keep the child in shade and bring everything they need. Here is how it works.
heroAlt: Parent holding a toddler in a sun hat under the boat canopy off Câmara de Lobos
keywords: can you take a baby on a boat trip in madeira
family boat trip madeira small children
baby sun protection on a boat
